description: This script is a shell script that sets up and tests a Git hook called 'post-index-change'. It includes functions for setting up test repositories, running specific Git commands, and verifying hook execution behavior under various scenarios. The script's purpose is to ensure the hook reacts correctly to different Git state changes and command-line flags.
